card.name: The D at the start of DRESS
card.fires_on: The letter D that begins the abbreviation DRESS, right after SJS and TEN in lists of severe skin reactions. It is found in label text about stopping or withholding a drug.

modes.label: DRESS after SJS and TEN
modes.description: The D that opens DRESS in a list of severe skin reactions, usually after 'or' or 'and'.
modes.example: In patients with SJS, TEN, or<< D>>RESS of any grade, discontinue CO

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of DRESS, the severe drug rash, when it is named alongside SJS and TEN.
